provenRuntimeFindings.finding: The original invoice was acquired and classified as invoice 1512 dated 2026-03-12 with printed document total EUR 6,426.92; all four window lines were extracted. The same source explicitly states 'Totale complessivo fornitura e posa in opera euro 9.010,00' before citing/deducting advance invoice 320. The missing-document label is therefore created only by the over-broad advance-reference gate, not by acquisition, classification or OCR.
provenRuntimeFindings.pipelineFaultPoint: resolveExplicitAdvanceInvoiceReferences treated every unmatched advance reference as a missing fiscal source even when the current invoice was self-contained by an explicit positive full-supply total.

provenRuntimeFindings.finding: Two standalone fiscal PDFs are acquired, including invoice 162. A further composite image contains both invoices and is parsed as invoice 162 referencing itself; self-reference filtering hides the independently acquired match.
provenRuntimeFindings.pipelineFaultPoint: crmLocalPreflight builds advance-invoice references from raw invoiceSegments before reconcileLocalInvoiceSegments retires the composite OCR duplicate. The economic path already consumes uniqueFinancialSegments, but the missing-original gate does not.

provenRuntimeFindings.finding: The 90/270-degree invoice pages are recognized by Vision but their bounding boxes are serialized with the unrotated reading-order comparator. Number, date and gross total are therefore scrambled before parsing.

The dossier contains a partial inline form plus a standard PraticaRapida paper form. crmLocalPreflight chooses the non-empty inline object wholesale and discards every field parsed from the paper form, instead of composing only absent fields. That leaves building/heating values empty even when the paper source carries them. Separately, checkbox marks whose position is lost by linear OCR still require a fail-closed positional reader before every value can be recovered.
provenRuntimeFindings.pipelineFaultPoint: crmLocalPreflight.ts selects `inlineForm` whenever it has any key (`const form = inlineForm ... ? inlineForm : parsedPaperForm`), so a partial source masks rather than complements the independent paper form.

provenRuntimeFindings.finding: The authoritative-invoice cardinality rule was invoked in all ten first-94 mismatch cases. It is not disconnected. The residual mismatches arise upstream because zero or ambiguous technical invoice items reach the resolver.
